note: Vaishno Devi route ground truth from the GSI Preliminary Note on the 26.08.2025 Ardhkuwari disaster: 1 dated fatal event + 39 GSI-surveyed instability locations (DMS, Table-7.1) along Tarakot-Adhkuwari, Bhawan-Sanjichat-Adhkuwari, Himkoti Marg and Banganga-Adhkuwari. CAVEATS for scoring: points hug the track corridor (corridor-biased inventory, like Ramban's NH-44 set) and most are GSI-assessed VULNERABLE spots (incl. observed old failures), not all occurred slides. Only the dated event feeds the temporal back-test.
